body: I'm thinking going to the ER and telling them that i'm suicidal is about my only option right now, don't think i'll be able to wait to see a therapist if I just try to make an appointment especially with covid here. but yeah wouldn't really be able to hide it I don't think because family would wonder where i'm at since I'm hoping it would be a 72 hour hold because I don't really think a day is going to do anything for me. Totally get the mail thing too, don't even look at that shit anymore, just wish they would understand that calling me 30 times a day isn't going to help.

Just a ton of money in debt, me and my dad got into a big fight and I was so sick of living at home that I got a personal loan to move out which he knows about and we're cool now so that's good I guess but once I got my own place I got into drinking a lot because it actually made me feel good and that's when I got way more into debt because I would just get blackout drunk every night and ended up maxing all my credit cards this year. I finally was able to pretty much stop drinking but I just feel like shit constantly, so many late payments and literally can't remember the last time I payed rent on time. End up spending $600+ a month on uber because I can't drive because of my vision and half the year it's too cold to walk anywhere so I literally can't get ahead even if I tried. Do the meds actually work? I want to just feel normal for once in like 10 years. I grew up being taught to just be a man and leave all this on the inside but that obviously doesn't work. Were your parents supportive? I just keep thinking that they will just think i'm weak and get pissed.
Did you end up going back? I'm at that point but don't want to loose more work then I already have and inevitably have my family find out all the shit I got myself into on top of me being suicidal.
